Both apparatus figures are fully framed below the gas discussion, with separate Figure 15 and Figure 16 captions, followed by the closing solid-deformation text and final limitation. No confirmed horizontal clipping, overlapping prose, caption collision, blank media or missing course ending.

Both figures fit their actual mobile widths and retain readable English labels, separate captions and following prose. Broader rounded vessel is visibly distinct from figure15. The corresponding apparatus, seven component labels and lower U-manometer area remain nonblank, unclipped and readable at both saved media widths.
